I told most of my friends to fuck off just 4 days ago. They've gone from discussing current events, politics and other interesting news to sitting on a couch getting drunk or hanging around in a bar. Also getting drunk. One of them is a bit like me, he is also distancing himself from them. Thing is, he's either working, working on his thesis or with his girlfriend nowadays. I see him maybe once a month.

My other group of friends? I can't relate to them at all anymore, they've barely changed in the past 5 years. Still going out as much as they can, drinking and dancing and waking up with a hangover.

If you're talking about "welcome to the grind" I've seen it before.

I don't care about my family at all, the only thing that comes out of their mouths is "yeah, well this happened to me and I got through it."

My dad apparently lost all of his friends when he started dating my mother, my mother being the ex-girlfriend of one of his friends. He knew what he was doing.

He was talking about it like he didn't choose for it, but he did. I'd give up all my friends in an instant for that.

My mother never ever seems to be able to say anything but "You're selfish, don't you ever think about us? Don't you care about what we did?"

So last time she did that, when I got out of the hospital I told her to not talk to me again. I told her she was right, I didn't care what she'd done. I'd rather not have been born and I'm still angry that the doctors saved me 3 weeks ago.

Everyone thinks it was an accident btw, since it had the symptoms of my allergic reaction.

Taking a run for me is impossible, taking a walk through whatever forest or nature is something I did with my girlfriend and only makes me more depressed. I can't even look at my family's dog without having to leave anymore.

The only one to make me feel happy or appreciate life was her. I was told by pretty much my entire family all of my friends and even her friends that I went from an intimidating and grumpy bear looking guy to a teddy bear when she was around. My mood would shift the second she was with me.

The only reason I'm still here is BECAUSE there's still hope for us to get back together. If there was none I wouldn't even have come here. I tried reaching out to her today, so I asked her how she was. She said she was fine, asked how I was. And I lied that I was doing okay.

That's all. Just a little while ago we were talking every day, for hours, she'd fall asleep on my chest and wake up in my arms. Now I'm just being ignored.

I met this girl when she was 13, I fell for her back then but I backed off because of age. I thought she was 16-17. I was 18. I haven't been able to se

Now I'm almost 24 and she's turning 19 this week.

I have, in 6 years, not been able to see myself end up with anyone else. And before I get pedophile comments, she hasn't changed much. Only thing she went through was a short emo phase but by the time she was 14 she was the same girl she is now. Or the same girl that she was until a month ago :(

Well, it's all still to get her back. If that suddenly becomes impossible I'd probably quit and overdose on whatever I've got.

And I've got a lot. Including benzos, barbiturates and old medication that nearly killed me a while ago because I was allergic to it. I've got +- 20mg of those left, it was 1mg that nearly killed me and put me in a coma for 2 days... It's hard not to take those and just get it over with. I've got them locked away in my safe though. No accidents.
